issue: Expo Metro resolved react to the @types/react directory and could not find an executable package entry
cause: The previous type-isolation change used directory aliases in the shared mobile tsconfig. Expo also consumes those aliases at runtime. Passing tsc did not validate Metro packaging.

fix.contract: The installed Expo 54 resolver explicitly skips .d.ts aliases. TypeScript still resolves mobile React 19 declarations; Metro uses executable React and JSX runtime modules.

coverage: Reproduce the original invalid @types/react directory entry
Installed Expo resolver skips explicit declaration aliases
React, jsx-runtime and jsx-dev-runtime resolve to executable React 19.1.0
TypeScript resolves the mobile React 19 declarations
Future @types aliases must explicitly end in .d.ts

limitations: JavaScript development bundling and production exports are not physical-device interaction or FPS verification.
The existing full non-lazy HTTP probe timed out while exports were running; the phone manifest's actual lazy/Hermes request subsequently returned 200.
An exploratory export:embed command with a relative entry path failed because the server root is the monorepo root. The correct phone entry and both normal platform exports passed.
No native App binary, API, Admin or database release was performed.
recovery: Reload JS on the phone. If the old error is cached, stop the existing Metro with Ctrl+C and restart with: pnpm --filter @novame/mobile start --dev-client --clear. Do not reinstall the App or erase user data.
